_doc: Global art specification. Every AI-generated asset must follow this file. Read by ArtCatalog (runtime) and ArtValidator (tooling). See docs/art/ART_SYSTEM.md.

style_guide.summary: Japanese anime illustration, high-quality visual-novel standing portraits.
rules: Japanese anime illustration, high-end visual novel quality
clean, refined line art with consistent line weight across all characters
soft cel shading with gentle gradient light, warm key light from upper left
vivid but not oversaturated colors (avoid neon / pure 100% saturation)
half-body standing portrait (head to upper thigh), facing the viewer, slight 3/4 allowed
transparent background, no shadows cast on the background
same head-to-body proportion and canvas framing for every character (see portrait.guides)
style_guide.positive_prompt: japanese anime illustration, visual novel character sprite, half body, clean lineart, soft cel shading, soft lighting, vibrant but natural colors, high detail, masterpiece, transparent background, simple flat background for cutout
style_guide.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, chibi, sketch, rough lines, oversaturated, neon colors, heavy shadows, text, watermark, signature, cropped head, extra fingers, deformed hands, multiple characters, background scenery, nsfw
style_guide.palette_rule: Each character's main colours come only from their bible (appearance.signature_colors). Never introduce new hair or eye colours during generation.

id_rules._doc: Segment IDs are lowercase letters/digits with optional hyphens. Underscore is reserved as the separator between filename segments.

naming._doc: Every image filename is derived from its manifest entry. {x} = one segment ID.

portrait._doc: All portrait layers (body, face, full) share this exact canvas so layers stack with no offsets.

guides._doc: Fractions of canvas height/width. Used for post-production alignment. Characters of different height keep the same pixel scale; only head_top moves.
guides.bottom_cut: upper thigh at canvas bottom edge

ui._doc: UI images have no fixed size; a manifest entry may declare width/height to enforce one.

layers._doc: Composition model. A portrait is either one 'full' image (pose x outfit x expression), or a 'body' layer (pose x outfit: the complete portrait with the default neutral face) plus an optional 'face' patch (pose x expression) drawn on top on the same canvas. The default expression needs no face patch. A face patch of a pose must fit every outfit of that pose; for NPC archetypes it may contain eyes/brows/mouth only (no hair) so it fits every look.

vocab._doc: Standard IDs. Characters pick from these so code, prompts and files agree. Adding a new ID here is allowed; renaming one is a breaking change.

fallback._doc: Resolution order when an image is missing. The game never crashes on a missing file; it steps down this list and finally draws a procedural silhouette marked as MISSING.

asset_status.missing: Planned but no file yet. Never shown as finished.
asset_status.draft: File exists, not yet reviewed against the bible.
asset_status.approved: Reviewed against the bible and art spec. Final.
asset_status.deprecated: Kept for history; not used by the game.
